scope: Make authored Publish 14.1 Politician skill-box progression authoritative by retiring the NGE residence/mayor bulk-grant compatibility helper without revoking legitimately earned skills or changing city and retained-content systems.

City election and administration code still checks social_politician_novice, so the skill-box profession remains meaningful when automatic grants fail closed.
